hero.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba — Infinity Castle
hero.date: Streaming since Mon Jul 28, 2026 — THE WAIT IS OVER
hero.about: The theatrical juggernaut finally hit Crunchyroll streaming on July 28 (announced at Anime Expo, arriving ahead of the old Sept/Oct guidance) — sub and dub, JustWatch-verified. First film of the Infinity Castle trilogy: Tanjiro and the Hashira are pulled into Muzan's shifting fortress for the war the whole series has been building toward.
hero.why: This has been pinned on your watchlist through four straight refreshes of 'theatrical-only.' It's here, it's a Loved-list franchise, and at 96% RT it delivers. Block out the 2h36m — this is the week's non-negotiable.

new_this_week.title: Trying S5
new_this_week.date: Eps 1–5 of 8 out; new eps Wednesdays through Aug 26 (Apple PR)
new_this_week.about: Esther Smith and Rafe Spall's London adoption comedy: this season Kat — Princess and Tyler's biological mother — arrives and upends the family. Collider calls it 'still Apple TV's best comedy.'

new_this_week.title: Ride or Die
new_this_week.about: Octavia Spencer discovers her best friend of 20 years (Hannah Waddingham) is an international assassin; a chaotic European road trip follows, with Bill Nighy along. JustWatch-verified on Prime. Note: aggregate is glowing (98%), though Variety was lukewarm.
new_this_week.why: This is The Heat / Spy energy in series form — buddy action-comedy with two ensemble greats. Your comedy-series guarantee, delivered with a 98% score.

new_this_week.title: Furious
new_this_week.date: Eps 1–4 of 8 streaming (JustWatch-verified); weekly through Aug 31
new_this_week.about: Elizabeth Meriwether (The Dropout) crime thriller inspired by 1987's Black Widow: Emmy Rossum's FBI agent hunts a calculating serial killer (Lola Petticrew) who targets wealthy men. Forbes calls it the best-reviewed show of 2026 so far.
new_this_week.why: The critical event of the summer, and it's on your newest platform. Cat-and-mouse plotting with twist mechanics — your thriller lane at prestige level.

new_this_week.title: The Dink
new_this_week.about: Jake Johnson as a washed-up tennis prodigy coaching at his father's (Ed Harris) country club who finds redemption in the paddle-court game sweeping the country. Ben Stiller produces; reviews say charming if formulaic.
new_this_week.why: Your comedy-movie slot for the week — an easy, warm 100 minutes. 'Try' because sports comedy is adjacent to (not inside) your usual lanes.

new_this_week.title: Futurama S14
new_this_week.date: Premiered Mon Aug 3, 2026 (2-ep premiere); weekly Mondays through Sep 28
new_this_week.about: S14 landed Monday with two episodes (JustWatch lists S14 E1–E2), then weekly Mondays through Sep 28. Season themes: space pirates, synthetic meat, elaborate scams. Three supersized specials follow in 2027 (Variety).
new_this_week.why: You're already watching Futurama on Disney+ — good news: a brand-new season started this week, and all 14 seasons are in the same app.

new_this_week.title: Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed — Final 3 Episodes (8–10)
new_this_week.date: Season complete since Jul 15, 2026 — 10 eps total (JustWatch-verified)
new_this_week.about: The Tatiana Maslany dark comedy finished its 10-episode run Jul 15 (finale 'Queens'). You caught up through Ep 7 (4-star, Jun 26); 'Hallidays' (E8), 'Erroneous' (E9), and the finale are up.
new_this_week.why: Three unwatched 30-min episodes close out a show you have at 4 stars — a one-evening finish.

new_this_week.title: Alien: Earth
new_this_week.date: S1 (8 eps) complete since Sep 2025 — NEW TO YOU with Disney+/Hulu
new_this_week.about: Noah Hawley's acclaimed FX series brings the xenomorph to Earth two years before the Nostromo. Full 8-episode season on Hulu; S2 is renewed and films in London this year (expected 2027).
new_this_week.why: Prestige sci-fi horror you literally could not stream before this week. Sci-fi + horror is your top-genre intersection.

new_this_week.title: Solar Opposites S6 (Final Season)
new_this_week.date: All 10 eps since Oct 13, 2025 — NEW TO YOU with Disney+/Hulu

new_this_week.title: The Bear S5 (Final Season)
new_this_week.about: The kitchen saga's final season dropped complete in June (finale 'The Original Beef of Chicagoland'). All 5 seasons on Hulu and Disney+.
new_this_week.why: Great acting and ensemble chemistry — squarely your signals — but it runs more stress-and-feelings than your escapism default, hence 'try.'

new_this_week.title: Human Vapor
new_this_week.about: Netflix's R-rated reimagining of Toho's 1960 classic by Yeon Sang-ho (Train to Busan): a detective and a reporter hunt a murderer who can turn his body to gas.
new_this_week.why: Dark sci-fi with a monster-mystery engine and twists — your dark-humor-adjacent thriller lane, well reviewed (~86–90% across snapshots).

new_this_week.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender S2 (live-action)
new_this_week.date: All 7 eps since Jun 25, 2026 (Netflix original; Variety/RT confirmed)
new_this_week.about: Team Avatar crosses the Earth Kingdom to Ba Sing Se; Aang learns earthbending from Toph while Azula hunts Zuko. Best-reviewed season of the live-action run.
new_this_week.why: Big world-building fantasy in a binge package. 'Try' — reviews are good-not-great and it skews a touch younger.

new_this_week.title: Batman: Caped Crusader S2
new_this_week.about: Bruce Timm's 1940s-noir Batman continues with the Riddler, Carrie Kelly, and Roxy Rocket. Ten 25-minute episodes, all at once.
new_this_week.why: Short-episode animated noir mystery — detective plotting in your pre-bed format.

new_this_week.title: Lucky
new_this_week.date: Eps 1–5 of 7 streaming (JustWatch-verified); Ep 6 Wed Aug 12, finale Aug 19
new_this_week.about: Anya Taylor-Joy as a con artist evading the FBI and a crime boss after a heist goes wrong; Annette Bening and Timothy Olyphant co-star. Adapts Marissa Stapley's novel.
new_this_week.why: Twisty con-artist thriller with novel-adaptation pedigree. Critics call it addictively binge-y (THR dissents); lands between your thriller and mystery lanes.

new_this_week.title: The Ghost in the Shell (2026)
new_this_week.date: Premiered Jul 7, 2026 — new eps Tuesdays (official Amazon PR)
new_this_week.about: Science SARU's new adaptation hews closer to Shirow's original manga: Major Kusanagi and Section 9 hunt the Puppet Master in 2029. Prime exclusive; check the Prime page for the latest episode.
new_this_week.why: Cyberpunk world-building in 24-min episodes from the studio behind Dandadan. Weekly anime slot outside Crunchyroll for a change.

critics.title: Furious

critics.why: Critic-validated buddy action-comedy squarely in your The Heat / Spy lane.

bench.title: What We Do in the Shadows
bench.about: Mockumentary about vampire roommates on Staten Island; series concluded in 2024 at six seasons.
bench.why: Deadpan supernatural ensemble comedy — the single best taste-profile match your new Hulu access unlocks. Start at S1E1.

bench.title: The Good Place
bench.about: Kristen Bell wakes up in a heaven she didn't earn; afterlife philosophy sitcom that reinvents itself every season.
bench.why: Built entirely on plot twists and world-building in 23-min episodes — the platonic ideal of your signals list.

bench.title: Extraordinary
bench.about: In a world where everyone gets a superpower at 18, Jen is still waiting for hers. Filthy, dry British comedy.
bench.why: Dry British humor + superpower world-building at 100% RT — a Fleabag-adjacent gem you couldn't stream until now.

bench.title: Shrinking
bench.about: Jason Segel's grieving therapist starts telling patients the truth; Harrison Ford in peak dry-wit mode. From the Ted Lasso team.
bench.why: Witty-banter ensemble comedy with substance underneath — your 'light(ish) tone with substance' signal, three seasons deep.

bench.title: The Afterparty
bench.about: A whodunit where each episode retells the same murder through a different film genre, one suspect at a time.
bench.why: Comedy + mystery + structural gimmicks that pay off — twisty ensemble fun in short episodes.

bench.title: Palm Springs
bench.about: Andy Samberg and Cristin Milioti stuck in a wedding-day time loop; dark edges, real plot engine.
bench.why: Sci-fi + off-beat comedy crossover — the best comedy movie your new Hulu access adds.

bench.title: Free Guy
bench.about: A video-game NPC becomes self-aware and decides to be the hero of his own story.
bench.why: Broad, world-building-driven sci-fi action comedy — an easy crowd-pleaser night.

bench.title: Bottoms
bench.about: Absurdist queer high-school fight-club satire with anarchic banter.
bench.why: Gleefully unhinged sarcastic comedy with LGBTQ+ inclusion — two of your signals; 'try' for the chaotic register.

bench.title: The Other Guys
bench.about: Will Ferrell and Mark Wahlberg as desk cops thrust into a real case; Adam McKay's buddy-cop send-up.
bench.why: Same big-broad-cop-comedy energy as The Heat, which you loved.

bench.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
bench.about: Reynolds and Jackman tear through the multiverse trading insults; the R-rated odd couple of the MCU.
bench.why: Relentless sarcastic banter and genre self-awareness — Disney+ catalog unlock; 'try' if superhero fatigue isn't in play.

bench.title: Murderbot
bench.about: A sarcastic security android that hacked its own governor module would rather watch soap operas than protect its humans. Adapts Martha Wells' novels.
bench.why: Dark humor + sci-fi in 26-min episodes from a beloved book series — this is your taste profile wearing a trench coat.

bench.title: For All Mankind
bench.about: The space race never ended: decade-spanning alt-history from Ronald D. Moore, now five seasons deep with a sixth and final season coming.
bench.why: The mothership of the Star City universe — warmer and more character-first than the spin-off you bounced off (2-star, Jun 2). If alt-history space appeals but the Soviet POV didn't, this is the version to try.

bench.title: The Expanse
bench.about: Solar-system conspiracy epic adapted from the James S.A. Corey novels; complete at six seasons.
bench.why: The best completed sci-fi binge for a Foundation fan — political intrigue, hard-SF world-building, and it sticks the landing.

bench.title: Fallout
bench.about: Post-apocalyptic wasteland satire mixing gore, retro-future world-building, and deadpan comedy; Walton Goggins' Ghoul is the draw.
bench.why: Dark humor + sci-fi is your named favorite combo — this is The Boys-adjacent tone in a wasteland.

bench.title: Andor
bench.date: Complete series — 2 seasons (JustWatch-verified via season pages)
bench.about: The Star Wars series for people who don't watch Star Wars: a slow-burn spy thriller about how rebellions actually start. Complete at two seasons.
bench.why: Prestige ensemble sci-fi thriller — Slow Horses tradecraft in a galaxy far, far away. Top Disney+ core unlock.

bench.title: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
bench.about: Rick Riordan's demigod adventures, faithfully adapted; S2 (Sea of Monsters) completed in early 2026.
bench.why: Greek-gods mythology like your 4★ Kaos, in a lighter register. 'Try' — it's family-skewed.

bench.title: The Wheel of Time
bench.about: Big-canvas adaptation of Robert Jordan's saga; S3 is its best-reviewed. Heads-up: cancelled after S3, so the show ends unresolved.
bench.why: Epic novel-adaptation fantasy with heavy mythology — go in knowing it stops mid-story.

bench.title: The Legend of Vox Machina
bench.about: Foul-mouthed D&D mercenaries with real serialized stakes; S4 finished its run in June (it was in your June alerts).
bench.why: Adult-animation fantasy with dark humor in 25-min episodes — four of your signals; S4 is fresh and binge-ready.

bench.title: Agatha All Along
bench.about: Kathryn Hahn's witch assembles a coven to walk the Witches' Road; twist-driven and notably queer Marvel spinoff.
bench.why: Witchy supernatural mystery with twists and LGBTQ+ inclusion — the Marvel entry most aligned with your signals.

bench.title: Midnight Mass
bench.about: An isolated island congregation gets a miracle-working new priest; slow-burn theological horror with a monster twist.
bench.why: Supernatural horror with a twist that recontextualizes everything — Flanagan's best, in your horror/suspense lane.

bench.title: The Haunting of Hill House
bench.about: Mike Flanagan's time-jumping haunted-family saga, loosely adapting Shirley Jackson; craft and twists over jump scares.
bench.why: Ensemble + novel adaptation + supernatural — three signals in the genre's modern benchmark.

bench.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
bench.about: A pharma dynasty's heirs die one by one, each death remixing a Poe story; a shape-shifting demon collects the debt.
bench.why: Dark humor + supernatural + ensemble body-count plotting — Flanagan at his most wicked.

bench.title: Ready or Not
bench.about: A bride's wedding night becomes a lethal game of hide-and-seek with her satanic in-laws. Gory, funny, fast.
bench.why: Horror-comedy in the Widow's Bay register — scares and laughs in one 96-minute sitting.

bench.title: Nope
bench.about: Jordan Peele's UFO western: ranch-owning siblings try to film the impossible thing in the sky.
bench.why: Sci-fi horror with Peele's twist mechanics — carried over from June's list, re-verified still on Netflix.

bench.title: The Night Agent
bench.about: A low-level FBI agent manning a dead phone line gets pulled into a White House conspiracy; three propulsive seasons.
bench.why: Twist-machine spy thriller — your Mission: Impossible / Slow Horses lane in binge form.

bench.title: Dept. Q
bench.about: An abrasive Edinburgh detective is banished to a basement cold-case unit with a team of misfits.
bench.why: Slow Horses-adjacent prickly-ensemble energy — dry wit over a twisty cold case. Direct hit for a Loved-list pattern.

bench.title: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
bench.about: Benoit Blanc skewers a tech-billionaire's murder-mystery weekend on a Greek island.
bench.why: Twisty, very funny ensemble whodunit — mystery + comedy + payoff twists in one movie night.

bench.title: Only Murders in the Building
bench.date: 5 seasons streaming (JustWatch-verified); S6 filming, late 2026 TBD
bench.about: Steve Martin, Martin Short, and Selena Gomez's true-crime-podcast trio; a new building murder every season. S6 (London) lands later this year.
bench.why: Witty banter + a twist-per-season mystery engine in 35-min episodes — and starting now gets you caught up before S6.

bench.title: A Good Girl's Guide to Murder
bench.about: Emma Myers' Pip digs into closed cases from Holly Jackson's bestselling trilogy; S2 adapts 'Good Girl, Bad Blood.'
bench.why: Plot-twisty novel-adaptation mystery, carried from June — 'try' for the YA tilt.

bench.title: Lord of the Flies
bench.about: Jack Thorne's hallucinatory 4-part Golding adaptation, carried over from June's list and re-verified on Netflix.
bench.why: 96% RT + novel adaptation + ensemble + LGBTQ+ subtext — four signals stacked; heavier than your default, but short.

bench.title: Shōgun
bench.about: The Emmy-sweeping feudal-Japan power-intrigue epic from James Clavell's novel; S2 films now for 2027.
bench.why: Dense political world-building + novel adaptation at 99% RT — the best drama your new platform adds.

bench.title: Bad Sisters
bench.about: Five Irish sisters plot the demise of a loathsome brother-in-law; Sharon Horgan's black-comedy thriller.
bench.why: Fleabag-adjacent dark wit stretched over a did-they-do-it structure — drama-length but never grim.

bench.title: The Diplomat
bench.about: Keri Russell as a crisis-magnet US ambassador to the UK; fast, talky, and twisty.
bench.why: Sharp-dialogue political intrigue that stays fun — drama without the sad.

bench.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
bench.date: S1 (28 eps) complete; S2 on Crunchyroll — 10 eps listed on JustWatch
bench.about: An elf mage outlives her hero party and re-walks their journey to understand what humans meant to her. S1 is complete; S2 episodes are up on Crunchyroll (10 listed on JustWatch).
bench.why: The best-reviewed fantasy anime of the decade — melancholy-but-warm, gorgeous world-building. Start with S1.

bench.title: The Apothecary Diaries
bench.date: S1–S2 complete (48 eps, JustWatch-verified); S3 just starting
bench.about: A sharp-tongued pharmacist solves poisonings in the imperial rear palace; episodic mysteries with serialized court intrigue. 48 episodes banked; S3 has just begun airing.
bench.why: Mystery-of-the-week plotting with a sarcastic lead — anime's answer to your witty-banter signal.

bench.title: Dandadan
bench.about: Aliens vs. ghosts vs. two bantering teens; Science SARU's chaotic, gorgeous genre mash-up.
bench.why: Supernatural + sci-fi + genuinely funny banter at 100% RT — the exact intersection of your top genres.

bench.title: Delicious in Dungeon
bench.date: S1 complete — 24 eps (JustWatch-verified; Netflix only, not Crunchyroll)
bench.about: Adventurers cook and eat the monsters they slay while descending to save their party member; deadpan D&D food comedy with real depth.
bench.why: Off-beat comedy + fantasy world-building — Studio Trigger making a monster-ecology cookbook into great TV.

bench.title: One Punch Man
bench.about: Saitama wins every fight in one punch and is desperately bored about it. Note: S1 is the classic; S3's animation drew criticism.
bench.why: You rated One Punch Man 4★ before — all three seasons now live in your Hulu hub, not Crunchyroll.

bench.title: Dorohedoro
bench.about: Caiman and Nikaido unravel his reptilian curse across an irradiated sorcerer-scarred city; S2 wrapped in May.
bench.why: Dark humor + post-apocalyptic fantasy in 25-min episodes — carried from June's list, re-verified.

bench.title: Devil May Cry
bench.about: Adi Shankar's demon-hunter saga; S2 (Dante vs. Vergil) held 100% across 13 reviews.
bench.why: Adult animation + action in your Solar Opposites lane — June pick, re-verified, both seasons ready.

bench.title: Saga of Tanya the Evil S2
bench.date: Airing weekly Wednesdays — premiered Jul 8, 2026; 12 eps
bench.about: First new season in nine years: a ruthless salaryman reincarnated as a child soldier-mage in a WWI-esque empire. New eps Wednesdays.
bench.why: Dark-fantasy isekai with war-room plotting — a weekly Crunchyroll slot while Re:ZERO is between cours.

bench.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation S3
bench.date: Airing weekly Sundays — premiered Jul 5, 2026; 27 eps across 2 cours
bench.about: The isekai genre's gold standard for long-arc payoff returns for season 3; new eps Sundays, dub running since Jul 18.
bench.why: Deep world-building fantasy on a weekly cadence — 'try' if you want a second airing anime alongside the Wednesday slots.
